notes: The base-titles table is player-facing at creation: db.c:3025 calls set_title(ch, NULL), which reads titles[GET_CLASS(ch)] (src/limits.c:41,258), and the room look lists each player as "Name Title" (list_one_char, src/act.informative.c:552). Six peers cover the five player-creatable classes plus the human ninja: "Basemage the Mage", "Basecleric the Cleric", "Basethief the Thief", "Basewarrior the Warrior" (line 1083) and "Baseninja the Ninja", "Basepsi the Psionic" (line 1084) (R1/R2/R5e).

Unreachable in C: creation accepts only magic-user, cleric, thief, warrior, psionic and the human ninja (valid_user_class_choice, src/interpreter.c:1674-1690), so "the Ranger"/"the Mystic" can never be READ_TITLE'd at creation (src/db.c:3025); the remorter assigns GET_CLASS directly without set_title (src/spec_procs2.c:754) and do_title always passes its argument (src/act.other.c:616), so no later NULL-title path re-reads the table for those two strings (R5e).
